budget_definition: At most1800seconds for the complete eight-run tuning stage and separately1800seconds for refit. No restarts or extensions. Assessment cap300seconds.
objective: Unweighted code cross entropy over observed queries. Existing context, GRU and code weights only. Fixed map features cached before updates. No new parameters, decoder, input fields, label changes or sampling of evaluation data.
selection: Four whole-game folds on original fitting groups, same initialization. Across both learning rates and epochs4..96 choose greatest pooled correct count, then smallest pooled code NLL, then earliest epoch, then smallest learning rate. Refit same configuration from the same initialization on all32fitting groups. Write selection before refit and any outer evaluation. No early success selection.
caveat: Backbone and discovery were previously trained on all fitting groups, including fold validation. These folds assess further weight updates, not fresh end-to-end generalization. All eight outer evaluation groups were previously exposed research data.
scope: User requests85percent inferred-code accuracy via existing neural weights. Report rare-code metrics and goal/movement effects. Original checkpoints preserved. No subagents, playing-bot changes or automatic promotion.
